name: Gartland

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large multi-section residence with a dark gray multi-gable roof|A wide paved driveway leads from the street to a parking area and garage at the front of the house|Landscaped xeriscape plantings and small trees surround the structure|A green lawn is visible in the rear yard|The property is located in a residential subdivision with neighboring homes nearby.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a modern multi-section home with a dark multi-gable roof|A wide paved driveway leads directly to the garage and front entry|Landscaped planting beds with small trees and shrubs line the front of the property|A sidewalk runs along the street frontage.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side elevation of the multi-section home|A fence runs along portions of this boundary|Landscaped areas and open ground are present near the structure|The front driveway and street are partially visible from this angle.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back elevation of the home with a green lawn area|The yard is enclosed by a fence|Outdoor space and hardscape are present behind the house|Neighboring properties are visible beyond the fence line.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side of the multi-section home and the paved driveway|Landscaped areas with small trees and shrubs run along this side|The rear lawn is partially visible|A fence borders portions of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a wide paved driveway that leads from the street directly to the front of the residence and garage, with space for vehicle staging. The front of the property is open and clearly accessible. The rear yard is fenced and contains a lawn area. Neighboring homes are close on multiple sides in this residential subdivision. Overall street access is straightforward, with good visibility of the front of the structure.
